instruction: Look at freecad_task-2_input.step in FreeCAD. Upgrade the L-shaped bracket without changing the base plate or rear vertical plate outer dimensions. Add five triangular reinforcing ribs on the inside corner, each 6 mm thick along X, located with mid-planes at X=18,44,70,96,122 mm; each rib must run from the base top at Z=12 to the rear wall and rise to Z=60 mm. Cut four horizontal through holes through the vertical plate along the Y direction, diameter 10 mm, centered at X=25,55,85,115 mm with Y=64 mm and Z=48 mm. In the base plate, cut two vertical obround through slots centered at (38,28) and (102,28), each total length 28 mm along X and width 10 mm. Add a top relief slot centered on each base slot, 34 mm long along X, 22 mm wide along Y, and 4 mm deep from the top face. Export the single fused bracket as /home/user/Desktop/freecad_task-2_output.step. You must complete all operations interactively through the GUI step by step. External script files are strictly prohibited.
